decisions.statement: Every page whose value is held in a file is answered in this one answer.
The pages acted on are every page property whose value is held in a file.
The endings stated are the ones the type beside that property already names.
A type that is no run of quoted endings is refused rather than passed over.
A page stating its endings already is passed over rather than stating them twice.
A run every page of which states its endings already is refused as no edit.
The endings are written after the page's definition.
One page's endings come in by one edit over that page.
One page refused refuses the whole change, and the refusal names that page.
A folder named holds the change to the pages sitting under that folder.
Nothing here writes the type those endings make.

definition: every file property told the endings the files that property has are named with
